mapper.update: UPDATE cps_check_item SET content = #{content}, check_types = #{checkTypes}, photo_min_count = #{photoMinCount}, photo_criteria = #{photoCriteria}, text_hint = #{textHint}, photo_category = #{photoCategory}, deduct_score = #{deductScore}, status = #{status}, applicable_room_types = #{applicableRoomTypes}, config_version = config_version + 1, enabled = #{enabled}, updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_inspection_area WHERE INSTR(CONCAT(',', REPLACE(check_item_ids, ' ', ''), ','), CONCAT(',', #{itemCode}, ',')) > 0 OR INSTR(CONCAT(',', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(check_item_ids, ' ', ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ','), CONCAT(',', #{id}, ',')) > 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_room WHERE INSTR(CONCAT(',', REPLACE(check_item_ids, ' ', ''), ','), CONCAT(',', #{itemCode}, ',')) > 0 OR INSTR(CONCAT(',', REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(check_item_ids, ' ', ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), '"', ''), ','), CONCAT(',', #{id}, ',')) > 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_inspection_type WHERE INSTR(CONCAT(',', REPLACE(check_item_ids, ' ', ''), ','), CONCAT(',', #{itemCode}, ',')) > 0) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_inspection_item WHERE item_code = #{itemCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_inspection_record_item WHERE check_item_id = #{id} OR item_code = #{itemCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_room_check_record_item WHERE check_item_id = #{id} OR item_code = #{itemCode}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cps_vision_check_record WHERE check_item_id = #{id})
